title: sprite.ts: shape tweens in symbol timelines silently omitted (missing DefineMorphShape2 + ratio placement)
description:
File: packages/swf/src/sprite.ts

Bug: encodeDefineSprite() has NO support for shape tweens inside symbol timelines. When a symbol has a layer with tweenType='shape' between two keyframes, the shapes are treated as ordinary shape objects and encoded as DefineShape4 (one per keyframe's display object). They are NOT encoded as DefineMorphShape2 (tag 84). No morph ratio PlaceObject2 is emitted; instead you get duplicate overlapping shapes placed at their start positions, with no interpolation.

compile.ts handles this correctly via:
1. A pre-pass (lines 1121-1193) that calls getTweenSpans() on each layer, finds shape-tween spans, and emits DefineMorphShape2 (tag 84) for each object pair (start→end), recording morphObjSpanInfo.
2. In the frame loop (lines 1710-1728), the morph ratio for each frame is computed using applyEase() and placed via encodePlaceObject2WithRatio().

sprite.ts has NONE of this. It lacks:
- Import of getTweenSpans and encodeDefineMorphShape2
- The DefineMorphShape2 pre-pass
- morphShapeObjIds / morphObjSpanInfo tracking structures
- The ratio computation in the frame loop
- The encodePlaceObject2WithRatio call path

Fix prescription:
1. Import getTweenSpans from '@flash/core' and encodeDefineMorphShape2, encodePlaceObject2WithRatio from the morphshape module.
2. In the sprite.ts pre-pass (before the regular per-layer loop at line 117), add a shape-tween pre-pass mirroring compile.ts lines 1121-1193:
   - For each layer, call getTweenSpans(layer)
   - For shape-tween spans, find start/end keyframes
   - Emit DefineMorphShape2 via hoistedDefs (same as other character definitions)
   - Record morphShapeObjIds (Set<string>) and morphObjSpanInfo (Map<string, spanInfo[]>)
3. In the frame loop placement section, before the type switch, check morphShapeObjIds.has(objId); if true, compute the ratio (same math as compile.ts lines 1714-1727) and emit encodePlaceObject2WithRatio instead of the usual DefineShape4 path.

Acceptance test: symbol timeline with a shape-tween layer (tweenType='shape', 10 frames); after encodeDefineSprite, the hoisted defs should contain a DefineMorphShape2 tag (not DefineShape4), and the sprite body should contain PlaceObject2 tags with HasRatio set.
